Elena (CS): Quick week0 check for Sapphire private/VPC onboarding. Main update: VPCs and roles validated, but two blockers: audit events sent to their SIEM are missing nested principal/session fields, and our KMS rotation step failed because the customer's alias includes a date suffix. Tagging @Raj and @Tess to triage. :wave:

Raj (Platform): Pinged. Can you paste a sanitized example and the exact error text? I want to repro against the staging mirror.

Elena (CS): Sure  

```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-07-21T16:02:11Z",
  "eventName": "StartInstances",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::333333333333:assumed-role/SapphireCross/DeployRole" }
  // expected: userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer (missing)
}
```
Rotation error (automation): `Error: KMS alias "alias/sapphire-prod-enc" not found` 1 actual alias in account is `alias/sapphire-prod-enc-2026-07-20` (our script expects the short alias).

Tess (Security): Two likely culprits: CloudTrail configured without management/global events OR the log-forwarder pipeline (Kinesis/Fluentd/Splunk) is normalizing/flattening nested JSON. I'll validate their trail settings (includeManagementEvents + includeGlobalServiceEvents) and check the delivery-role's trust policy. If the forwarder is stripping fields, we'll add a required config snippet to the onboarding runbook. ETA: tomorrow 11:30 PT.

HealthBot: smoke-suite: 1829990001 | checks: network:ok iam:ok kms:fail audit:fail | artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/sapphire/week0/1829990001

Raj (Platform): I ran the local mirror, saw same failures. Quick mitigation: I can make the rotation script tolerant to date-suffixed aliases (regex fallback) and add a preflight that maps existing alias to expected name. I can push a small patch (v0.1) today and include a unit test. Will also note a temporary egress rule I opened for their SIEM collector (TLS SNI allowance)  

Elena (CS): Proposed plan: (1) Raj implements alias-tolerant rotation + validation by EOD; (2) Tess confirms whether CloudTrail or forwarding pipeline is the cause and provides exact remediation steps or runbook text by tomorrow noon; (3) If both items remain open by Fri 18:00 PT tag a medium renewal risk and schedule a customer remediation call next Tue.

Tess (Security): Agreed. If it's CloudTrail, fix is straightforward (enable management events + global events). If it's the forwarder, we'll capture the exact Fluentd filter config that preserves `sessionContext` and add it to the onboarding checklist.

Raj (Platform): Patch pushed to feature/suffix-alias (PR: https://git.redwood/p/3421). Smoke re-run pending. I'll drop the artifact link in the sync.

Elena (CS): Scheduling a 25m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to review PR + artifacts. I'll DM Sapphire ops a short summary and request temporary read-only log access (or a sample delivery stream) if Tess needs it.

HealthBot: reminder: weekly-health-scan scheduled for 2026-07-23T15:00:00Z

Elena (CS): Final note: adding Sapphire to week0-health folder and renewal-watchlist until both items are cleared. Thanks everyone. :pray:
